solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• Its correct spelling is **'Contextual'**.
 
• **Contextual** means **depending on or relating to the circumstances that form the setting for an event, statement, or idea.**(संदर्भगत)
 
 
• **Example**: *By contrast, written language found in books has no such **contextual **support.*
